definition: free from bad, immoral habits.
example_en: That youth free from bad habits was a model for the whole village.

definition: the disc of the moon.
example_en: The poet wrote a poem about the disc of the moon.

definition: to sling mud at.
example: ರಾಜಕೀಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಎದುರಾಳಿಗಳು ಒಬ್ಬರ ಮೇಲೆ ಒಬ್ಬರು ಕರ್ದಮಂಬೊರೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: In politics, opponents sling mud at each other.

definition: a lending of money on the condition that the person taken it would pay the interest on it.
example_en: Under the kusida system, the borrower had to pay interest.

definition: a man having bad luck; an unfortunate man.
example_en: The unfortunate man suffered losses everywhere.

definition: the gist of anything.
example_en: The gist of life lay hidden in the teacher's words.

definition: (only in comp.) not the same; distinct; separate; other; different.
example_en: This is the custom of a different village, not of this place.

definition: a completing or being completed; completion.
example_en: This problem is related to a mathematics question.

definition: absence of connection or relation.
example_en: The lack of coherence was clearly evident in that essay.

definition: the exchange of opinions, discussing about the pros and cons of; discussion.
example_en: Everyone exchanged opinions in the meeting.

definition: a passageway made for escaping.
example_en: The prisoners escaped through the secret passageway.

definition: a stack of straw, hay etc.
example_en: A stack of straw stood ready beside the paddy field.

definition: (hist.) a kind of tax.
example: ಆ ಕಾಲದ ಜನರು ಹದಿಕೆ ತೆರಿಗೆಯನ್ನು ಕಟ್ಟುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: People of that era used to pay the hadike tax.

definition: along with; together with.
example_en: He set out on the trip along with his wife.

definition: a man who has the right to inherit an ancestral property.
example_en: The heir received the ancestral property.

definition: injustice i.e. a) the quality of being unjust or unfair; lack of justice; wrong; b) deprival of justice; c) an unjust act.
example: ಅವನಿಗೆ ಆದ ಅನ್ನಯ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಸಹಾನುಭೂತಿ ಗಳಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The injustice done to him earned everyone's sympathy.

definition: a man who fills; a filler.
example_en: That filler filled water into the pots.

definition: a group, multitude of pupils (of a teacher).
example_en: The guru's group of pupils used to come to the hermitage every day.

definition: the sun.
example: ಪೊೞ್ತು ನೆತ್ತಿಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಂದೊಡನೆ ಬಿಸಿಲು ಏರಿತು.
example_en: As the sun reached overhead, the heat rose.

definition: a formal and binding declaration that one will do or refrain from doing something; an oath.
example_en: He gave a solemn oath before the assembly.

definition: a variety in cucumber; a wild cucumber.
example_en: Wild cucumber is found in the forest.

definition: the wind.
example_en: The wind shook the leaves of the tree.

definition: the quality of being melodious or sweet.
example: ಆ ಹಾಡಿನ ಇಮ್ಮು ಎಲ್ಲರ ಮನಸ್ಸನ್ನು ಸೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The melodious sweetness of that song drew everyone's heart.

definition: a portable fire pan, that uses charcoal as fuel.
example_en: In winter, we sat near the portable fire pan and got warm.

definition: to arrange in a right or proper order, manner.
example_en: The teacher arranged the words in proper order.

definition: a Śaiva sect founded in the twelfth century in Karnāṭaka.
example_en: The Veerashaiva sect has many followers in Karnataka.

definition: to give a massage to; to massage.
example_en: She massaged the baby's body with oil.

definition: a living without having self-respect; a deplorably menial life.
example_en: Death is better than living a deplorably menial life without self-respect.

definition: a large, leaf like part the areca flower cluster; a spathe.
example_en: A spathe fell from the areca tree.

definition: a little boy or girl.
example_en: The little child walked holding its mother's saree end.

definition: the lark Mirafra cantillans of Alaudidae family, smaller in size than house sparrow, with light brown body, light brown wings with dark brown spots, dull white breast, white brow, short, somewhat forked tail, brown legs and bill, that nests on the ground; singing bush-lark.
example: ಭರತಪಕ್ಷಿ ನೆಲದ ಮೇಲೆ ಗೂಡು ಕಟ್ಟಿ ಮೊಟ್ಟೆ ಇಡುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The singing bush-lark builds its nest on the ground and lays eggs.

definition: to enter in a register, book of accounts, etc.; to record.
example: ಗುಮಾಸ್ತ ಖಾತೆ ಪುಸ್ತಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲ ವೆಚ್ಚವನ್ನು ದಾಖಲಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The clerk recorded all the expenses in the account book.

definition: the name of an old country corresponding to the present Gujarat state in the western part of India.
example: ಲಾಟ ಎಂಬುದು ಇಂದಿನ ಗುಜರಾತಿನ ಒಂದು ಭಾಗವಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: Lata was a part of present-day Gujarat.

definition: excessiveness of quantity, triumph or excellence.
example_en: Seeing the excessive abundance of the crop, the farmer was delighted.

definition: a domineering and haughtily or rudely arrogant man.
example_en: Nobody likes the words of that arrogant man.

definition: to go or come up; to mount; to ascend.
example_en: The boy easily climbed up and ascended the tree.

definition: an indeclinable used to express ones disgust, loathsomeness, dislike, etc.
example: ಧಿಕು, ಇಷ್ಟು ಸುಳ್ಳು ಹೇಳುವುದು ನಿನಗೆ ನಾಚಿಕೆಯಿಲ್ಲವೇ?
example_en: Fie, have you no shame in telling so many lies?

definition: a servant of a hunter, who chases a prey animal.
example: ಬೇಟೆಗಾರನ ಜೊತೆ ಒಬ್ಬ ಅಟ್ಟುಳಿಯಾಳು ಕಾಡಿಗೆ ಹೋದನು.
example_en: A hunter's chasing servant went into the forest with him.

definition: (jain.) the atmosphere that is surrounding the earth.
example_en: In Jain doctrine the atmosphere surrounds the earth.

definition: the action of a hallucinated man.
example_en: People laughed seeing his hallucinated man's antics.

definition: miscellaneous tax; a tax on miscellaneous items.
example_en: Traders had to pay the miscellaneous tax.

definition: mastery over the art of alchemy.
example: ಆ ಸಾಧು ರಸಸಿದ್ಧಿಯನ್ನು ಪಡೆದಿದ್ದನೆಂದು ಜನ ನಂಬಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: People believed that the sage had attained mastery over alchemy.

definition: forcefully; using force.
example_en: The wind shut the door forcefully.

definition: a ritualistic declaration, typically based on an appeal to a god or to some revered person or object, that one will accomplish a very difficult or almost impossible task.
example: ಅವನು ದೇವರ ಮೇಲೆ ಕಡುಭಾಷೆ ಮಾಡಿ ಹೊರಟನು.
example_en: He made a solemn vow before God and set out.

definition: following; succeeding.
example_en: Answers were found to his following questions.

definition: to taper or sharpen one end of a writing-pencil.
example_en: One must sharpen the pencil before writing.

definition: a being hopeful of getting something that is desired.
example: ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಪ್ರತ್ಯಾಶೆ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: He had a hopeful expectation about the exam results.

definition: to hand or pass over the possession or control to someone; to give.
example_en: The king was giving away land to the poor man.

definition: a set of six vices (as lust, anger, avrice, fondness or infatuation, arrogance and jealosy) considered as the enemies within.
example_en: Seekers try to conquer the six inner enemies.

definition: to be dissatisfied; to have displeasure.
example_en: Displeased at his words, the friend fell silent.

definition: confined within limits; restricted or circumscribed; limited.
example_en: This scheme is limited to just one district.

definition: a weapon consisting of a long shaft, with a pointed end, used for throwing at or stabbing; a spear.
example_en: The soldier threw a spear at the enemy.

definition: a large, cultivated planting of trees; a plantation.
example_en: There is a large plantation of trees outside the village.

definition: to cause to enter into; to make something go in.
example_en: The guard made them enter inside.

definition: emancipating the soul and bestowing salvation.
example_en: They say this mantra grants salvation.

definition: very melodious, tuneful; mellifluous.
example_en: Her song sounded very melodious.

definition: a person who pities and helps another or others unselfishly in times of difficulty; a good Samaritan.
example: ಆಪದ್ಬಾಂಧವನಾದ ಅವನು ಬಡವರಿಗೆ ಸದಾ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: He is a good Samaritan who always helps the poor.

definition: a procession taken for celebrating a festival.
example: ಜಾತ್ರೆಯ ದಿನ ದೇವರ ಪಾರ್ವಾಟ ಊರೆಲ್ಲಾ ಸುತ್ತಿತು.
example_en: On the festival day, the deity's celebratory procession went around the whole village.

definition: (collectively) a number of embankments around a castle or castles.
example_en: The enemies tried to breach the ring of embankments around the castles.

definition: being intolerant of any other system of belief and worship, ethical code or philosophy, other than one's own.
example_en: Bigoted people do not tolerate other religions.

definition: a wise, prudent move, behaviour or action.
example: ಅವನ ಜಾಣ್ಣಡೆ ಇಡೀ ಸಂಕಷ್ಟದಿಂದ ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನು ಪಾರುಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: His wise move saved everyone from the entire crisis.

definition: act of opposing; opposition.
example_en: His opposition became an obstacle to all the plans.

definition: to refuse to take, accept, agree to; to reject.
example_en: She rejected that agreement.

definition: any of of the insects of the Blattaria order, with long antennae and a flat, soft body; a cockroach.
example_en: A cockroach was scurrying about in the kitchen.

definition: an enemy of god; a demon.
example_en: The gods waged war to defeat the enemy of god.

definition: to seem to be correct, right.
example_en: His words seemed to be correct.

definition: that which is flat or flattened.
example_en: Grandmother dried the flattened wafer in the sun.

definition: a group of persons, animals or things gathered together at a place; a crowd.
example_en: There was a huge crowd of people in the market.

definition: to hold or bind by or as if by a spell; to capture by fascination. 2) to impede the growth or the tendency to grow.
example: ಆ ಮಾಟಗಾತಿ ಜನರನ್ನು ಮಂಕುಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ ಎಂದು ಜನ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: People say that sorceress captures people by fascination.

definition: a sort of coarse hempen cloth; canvas.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಹಾಯಿಗಾಗಿ ಕಿತ್ತಾನ್ ಎಂಬ ಒರಟು ನಾರಿನ ಬಟ್ಟೆಯನ್ನು ಉಪಯೋಗಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: For the old sail, they used a coarse hempen cloth called canvas.

definition: a dwelling place; a house; a home.
example_en: This is his dwelling place; he lives right here.

definition: to cause to become dented.
example_en: He dented the metal sheet by beating it with a hammer.

definition: an irrigational channel under the direct control and maintenance of the government.
example_en: The government constructed a government-maintained irrigation channel for the village.

definition: to drive (a vehicle, horse, etc.) fast.
example_en: The driver drove the bus very fast.

definition: together with; along with.
example_en: He went to his hometown together with his friends.

definition: (pl.) two stakes bet in a wager, game or contest.
example_en: They put two stakes as wager in the game.

definition: to refuse to take, accept, agree to; to reject.
example_en: In the meeting they rejected that suggestion.

definition: a book for keeping record of one's own daily experience, thoughts, events, etc.; a diary.
example: ಅವನು ತನ್ನ ಚಿಟ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಘಟನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಬರೆದಿಟ್ಟಿದ್ದಾನೆ.
example_en: He has written down all the events in his diary.

definition: the tip of one's finger nail.
example_en: The tip of his finger nail broke and hurt him.

definition: to come in or form a line.
example_en: All the disciples formed a line behind the teacher.

definition: (flies) to make a with continuous murmuring sound while flying off in a swarm.
example_en: The flies flew off in a swarm, murmuring continuously.

definition: an officer at taluk or subdivisional level in the revenue department.
example_en: The revenue officer examined the land records.

definition: the stalk of certain plants as jowar, which is used as fodder.
example_en: They had piled up jowar stalks in the field.

definition: the annual herb Coriandrum sativum of Apiaceae family; the coriander plant.
example_en: Grandmother has grown coriander in the courtyard.

definition: the reddish-brown or reddish-yellow coating formed on iron or steel by oxidation, when exposed to air and moisture; rust.
example_en: Rust formed on the iron that got soaked in the rain.

definition: an apparatus for shooting fiery crackers.
example: ಹಬ್ಬದ ರಾತ್ರಿ ಆಕಾಶಕೊಳವೆಯಿಂದ ಪಟಾಕಿಗಳನ್ನು ಆಕಾಶಕ್ಕೆ ಹಾರಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: On the festival night, they shot fireworks into the sky using the rocket-launching tube.

definition: to make a sound by repeatedly striking a metal cup (as of the bell fixed to a bicyclṛs frame).
example_en: The bicycle bell made a clanging sound.

definition: to (cause to) thrust, drop or dip into water or any other liquid so as to make it covered completely; immerse.
example_en: He immersed the cloth in the colored water.

definition: covered by forest; wooded; sylvan.
example_en: There are tigers in that forest-covered region.

definition: pasta made of wheat flour in the form of long, thin strings, cooked by boiling or steaming and served with a sauce; spaghetti.
example: ಅಮ್ಮ ಟೊಮೇಟೊ ಸಾಸ್ ಜೊತೆ ಸೇವಗೆ ಬಡಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: Mother served spaghetti with tomato sauce.

definition: to run or rush toward.
example_en: The children rushed toward their mother.

definition: a peon orderly or office assistant.
example_en: The peon delivered the letter to the officer.

definition: (a slender, sharp piece) to come out (of a wood).
example_en: A splinter came out from the door's plank.

definition: money; a sum of money.
example: ಅವನು ಅಂಗಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ರಖಂ ಕೊಟ್ಟು ಸಾಮಾನು ಕೊಂಡನು.
example_en: He paid money at the shop and bought the goods.

definition: a kind of Vīṇe, a stringed musical instrument.
example_en: In ancient times, sages used to play the rudravīrya.

definition: a man of extraordinary gallantry.
example_en: The man of extraordinary gallantry faced the enemies alone in battle.

definition: the sugar cane plant Saccharum officinarum of Poaceae family.
example_en: Sugar cane had grown all over the field.

definition: one's own handwriting.
example_en: He wrote the letter in his own handwriting.

definition: carrying or engaged in carrying, news, information.
example_en: That bird carries out the work of conveying news.

definition: a vigilant guarding by armed forces.
example: ಗಡಿಯ ಕಟ್ಟಣಿಗಾವಲು ದಿನದ ಇಪ್ಪತ್ತನಾಲ್ಕು ಗಂಟೆಯೂ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The vigilant guarding of the border continued twenty-four hours a day.

definition: that may or is liable to be ruined, spoiled; that may perish; perishable.
example: ಈ ದೇಹವು ನಾಶ್ಯವಾದುದು ಎಂದು ಅವನಿಗೆ ತಿಳಿದಿದೆ.
example_en: He knows that this body is perishable.

definition: a kind of soft slate-pencil used to write on slates.
example_en: The children were given soft slate-pencils at school.

definition: a (woman's) parent's house.
example: ಮಗುವಿನ ಜೊತೆ ತವರ್ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲವು ದಿನ ಇರು.
example_en: Stay a few days at your parents' house with the child.

definition: the act or process of moving; movement.
example_en: The movement of the clouds was visible across the sky.

definition: a flat, wide, plate made intertwining thin bamboo splits.
example: ಆ ಪಡಲಿಗೆಯನ್ನು ಬಿದಿರಿನ ಸಪೂರ ಸಳಿಗಳಿಂದ ಹೆಣೆದಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: That flat plate had been woven from thin bamboo splits.

definition: to strike against.
example_en: The boat struck against the rock.

definition: (pl.) fruits (of different kinds).
example_en: Various kinds of fruits were on sale in the market.

definition: he who breaks faith with or betrays another's trust; a betrayer.
example_en: That betrayer deceived his own friend.

definition: a loud announcement; the act of so announcing.
example_en: They made a loud announcement in the village to spread the news.

definition: eager willingness; readiness, often manifested by quick, lively action; alacrity; enthusiasm; zest.
example_en: The soldiers set out for battle with alacrity.

definition: a human being.
example_en: A human being is a creature that lives in society.

definition: (pl.) the five divisions of a whole.
example_en: The ancient text has a description of the five divisions.

definition: to consider carefully and in detail.
example: ಒಪ್ಪಂದದ ಎಲ್ಲ ಷರತ್ತುಗಳನ್ನೂ ಅವನು ಪರಾಂಬರಿಸಿ ಸಹಿ ಹಾಕಿದನು.
example_en: He considered all the conditions of the agreement carefully before signing.

definition: a mode of saluting holding one's ears, kneeling before and touching the forehead to the ground.
example_en: The disciple saluted the teacher, kneeling and holding his ears in reverence.

definition: one who or that which causes precipitation; a precipitating agent.
example: ಆ ರಾಸಾಯನಿಕ ದ್ರಾವಣದ ಅವಕ್ಷೇಪಕವಾಗಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: That chemical acted as a precipitating agent for the solution.

definition: to shout aloud.
example: ಹುಡುಗನು ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ಮೇಲಿನಿಂದ ಆಲುತ್ತಾ ಸ್ನೇಹಿತರನ್ನು ಕರೆದನು.
example_en: The boy shouted aloud from the hilltop, calling his friends.

definition: immediately; at once.
example_en: As lightning struck, the light appeared immediately.

definition: anything used to cover; a cover; a covering for the hand with separate sheath for each finger and the thumb; a glove.
example_en: He wore a glove to protect himself from the cold.

definition: the sound uttered by dogs in pain.
example_en: The dog cried kuyi in pain.

definition: a thin web that grows on the retina, that blurs and blinds the vision.
example_en: His vision has become blurred due to a web on the retina.

definition: a building with a small tower on it.
example_en: There was a small towered building in the middle of the village.

definition: a man who sells perfumes.
example_en: The perfume seller was selling scents in the market.

definition: the middle of the night, twelve o'clock at night.
example_en: It rained heavily at midnight.

definition: a dark, astringent, resin-like substance, rich in tannin, extracted from that tree which is used with betel leaves and areca nut, in medicine, and for dyeing, tanning, etc.; (?).
example_en: Grandmother was chewing the resin-like substance along with the betel leaf.

definition: the direction to the left of a person facing north; it is the point on the horizon at which the centre of the sun sets at the equinox; west.
example_en: The sun set in the west.

definition: the present time.
example_en: This news does not relate to the present time.

definition: a crab, that burrows in the ground.
example_en: The burrowing crab lives by digging holes in the ground.

definition: preceding all others in a series; before any other; first.
example_en: She secured the first rank in the examination.

definition: marked with or as with a scar.
example_en: His face was covered with scarred skin.

definition: a strong wish or craving; a desire.
example_en: The people's craving for freedom gave rise to the movement.

definition: the act of purging.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರು ಅವನಿಗೆ ಜುಲಾಬು ಆಗುವ ಔಷಧಿ ಕೊಟ್ಟರು.
example_en: The doctor gave him a purgative medicine.

definition: the act, process or work of repeatedly revising (esp. a passage to commit it to memory).
example_en: One must revise every day to remember the lesson.

definition: that which is of second grade, quality, etc.
example_en: This cloth is of second-rate quality.

definition: a bad-tempered man.
example_en: Everyone at home keeps away from that bad-tempered man.

definition: the occult learning of vedic hymns and other sacred texts.
example_en: That scholar was well versed in the occult learning of sacred hymns.

definition: to float - a) to stay on the surface of a liquid; b) to drift or move slowly or easily on water.
example: ಮೀನುಗಾರನ ಬಲೆ ಕೆರೆಯ ನೀರಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ತೆಕ್ಕಾಡುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The fisherman's net was floating on the surface of the lake water.

definition: belonging to, is born in, made in Bengal (either West Bengal in India or Bangla Desh).
example: ಆ ಬಂಗಾಳಿ ಸಾಹಿತಿ ಅನೇಕ ಕವಿತೆಗಳನ್ನು ಬರೆದನು.
example_en: That Bengali writer wrote many poems.

definition: not feeling thirst; free from thirst.
example_en: He became free from thirst after drinking water.

definition: a kind of agricultural land.
example_en: That type of agricultural land was fertile in the village.

definition: (masc.) one who dwells in a hermitage; a hermit.
example_en: That hermit lived peacefully in the forest.

definition: wicked; dishonest; deceitful; rascal; cheating.
example: ಆ ದುರುಳ ಮನುಷ್ಯ ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನೂ ಮೋಸ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: That wicked man cheated everyone.

definition: disgustingly offensive dirt, garbage, etc.
example_en: Disgustingly offensive garbage had piled up behind the house.

definition: a royal family.
example_en: The history of that royal family is very famous.

definition: one of the three great divisions of modern Hinduism, that regards Viṣṇu as the Supreme Being (the others being Śaiva and Śakta).
example_en: Vaishnava devotees worship Vishnu as the Supreme Being.

definition: to reach postal letters (to their respective addressees).
example: ಅಂಚೆಯವನು ಪ್ರತಿ ದಿನ ಓಲೆಯಡಕುವ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: The postman does the work of delivering letters every day.

definition: the act, process or an instance of listening.
example: ಗುರುಗಳ ಉಪದೇಶದ ಕೇಳ್ಮೆಯಿಂದ ಮನಸ್ಸಿಗೆ ಶಾಂತಿ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿತು.
example_en: Listening to the teacher's sermon brought peace to the mind.

definition: the act or an instance of sprouting (as from a spore or seed).
example_en: Sprouting occurred from the seed.

definition: a canal or large pipe over a bridge-like structure, for bringing water from a distant place; a aqueduct.
example_en: Water comes to the village through the aqueduct.

definition: the planet that we live on; the earth.
example_en: In the puranas, aditi is described both as a goddess and as the earth.

definition: to draw a thin, thread-like wire from gold, silver or other metal.
example_en: The goldsmith is skilled at drawing thin wire from silver.

definition: a kind of skin disease.
example: ಆತನಿಗೆ ಆತಿಗುವಿ ಎಂಬ ಚರ್ಮ ರೋಗ ಬಂದಿದೆ.
example_en: He has a skin disease called atiguvi.

definition: (pros.) a kind of meter in which two lines are grouped as one unit for alliteration purpose and each line having four groups of five units each.
example_en: The poet composed the verse in the toma meter.

definition: immediately and forcefully.
example_en: He closed the door immediately and forcefully.

definition: anything that is in extreme degree.
example_en: His anger, being extreme, frightened everyone.

definition: an accusing or being accused; accusation.
example_en: The customer made an accusation against the shopkeeper.

definition: the ability required for moving.
example_en: As he grew old, his ability to move decreased.

definition: something given as a gift, esp. to a temple, revered person, etc. or to a king, monarch, etc.; tribute.
example_en: The devotees offered a tribute to the temple.

definition: suddenly and violently.
example_en: The door opened suddenly and violently.

definition: wet, soggy earth or something resembling this; slush; mire.
example_en: The entire field was full of mire.

definition: the quality of being common or ordinary; ordinariness; commonness.
example_en: This custom has become commonplace in the village.

definition: name of one of the Dravidian languages.
example_en: Parji is a Dravidian language.

definition: the number,volume or quantity that is equal to, one and half of.
example: ಆ ಚೀಲದಲ್ಲಿ ದೀಡ ಕೆಜಿ ಅಕ್ಕಿ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was one and a half kg of rice in that sack.

definition: the plant Berberis aristata of Berberidaceae family.
example_en: The Berberis aristata plant grows naturally on the hill.

definition: that which has or is made of different colours, as a painting, picture, etc.
example_en: They had painted a colourful picture on the wall.

definition: a group or clan of Jaina mendicants belonging Tamil Nadu.
example: ಆ ದ್ರವಿಳಗಣ ತಮಿಳುನಾಡಿನಿಂದ ಬಂದ ಜೈನ ಸನ್ಯಾಸಿಗಳ ಗುಂಪು.
example_en: That group of Jaina mendicants came from Tamil Nadu.

definition: to pay the tax that is due.
example_en: The farmers paid the tax due to the government.

definition: to shine sparkingly; to sparkle.
example_en: The stars were sparkling in the night sky.

definition: subject to the influence, force or control of time or destiny.
example_en: Human life is subject to the control of time.

definition: an indeclinable used to express one's appreciation; 'well', 'good' 'right', etc.
example_en: The teacher expressed appreciation saying 'well done'.

definition: a place or region etc. which is outside.
example: ಅವನು ಬಹಿಯ ಕಡೆಗೆ ಹೋಗಿ ಮನೆಗೆ ಬರಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: He went towards the outside area and did not return home.

definition: a stroke; a blow.
example_en: The blow of his hand struck the chest.

definition: the ability to perform, carrying out a work; the quality of being capable; practical ability; capability.
example_en: The work finished quickly due to his capability.

definition: an extent of agricultural land leased out.
example_en: The farmer grew paddy on the leased agricultural land.

definition: a man who sells gold and silver articles, jewlry, etc.
example: ಆ ಸರಾಫ ಬೀದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಚಿನ್ನ ಬೆಳ್ಳಿ ಆಭರಣಗಳ ಅಂಗಡಿ ಇಟ್ಟಿದ್ದಾನೆ.
example_en: That jeweler has set up a shop of gold and silver ornaments on the street.

definition: a container made of a long cloth by joining and tying four corners together, that can be hanged on to one's shoulder.
example: ಅವನು ಜೋಲಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅಕ್ಕಿ ಕಟ್ಟಿ ಹೆಗಲ ಮೇಲೆ ಹೊತ್ತ.
example_en: He tied rice in a cloth bag and carried it on his shoulder.

definition: the palm of the hand;
example_en: There was a wound on his palm.

definition: the last part of anything; final point; finish; completion; conclusion; the end.
example_en: At the end of the story everyone fell silent.

definition: to be selected by other members or large number of people, as their representative, to an office.
example_en: That candidate was elected to the village panchayat.

definition: a building set apart or consecrated for Christian worship; a church.
example_en: There is an old church in the middle of the town.

definition: an excellent brāhmaṇa.
example: ಊರಿನ ಪೆರ್ವಾರ್ವ ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ವೇದ ಪಾಠ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: The excellent brahmana of the town was teaching Vedic lessons to the children.

definition: the act of cutting, severing.
example_en: The severing of the rope happened accidentally.

definition: having no use; unserviceable; worthless.
example_en: This old box is now useless.

definition: an act of jumping; a jump.
example_en: The child's jump astonished everyone.

definition: trifling; insignificant; unimportant; trivial.
example_en: There is no need to worry about such a trivial matter.

definition: the brown honey.
example_en: Grandmother mixed brown honey and prepared the medicine.

definition: the act of remembering or recollecting the facts of one's previous life.
example_en: That yogi experienced the recollection of his previous life during meditation.

definition: the cardinal twenty; 20.
example_en: There were twenty students in the classroom.

definition: the plant Securinega leucopyrus (= Flueggea leucopyrus) of Euphorbiaceae family.
example_en: The nelamagali plants had grown at the foot of the hill.

definition: the act or an instance of cheating.
example_en: That merchant's act of cheating was eventually exposed.

definition: to work as a slave.
example_en: He worked as a slave for his master his whole life.

definition: a man who is lonely.
example: ಆ ಎಕ್ಕಲ ಊರಿನಿಂದ ದೂರ ಒಂಟಿಯಾಗಿ ವಾಸಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That lonely man lived far from the village all by himself.

definition: the state or time of being a child or boy; boyhood.
example_en: His boyhood was spent in the village.

definition: a thin, vertical line of hair running from the bosom to the lower part of the belly.
example: ಅವನ ಎದೆಯಿಂದ ಹೊಟ್ಟೆಯವರೆಗೆ ರೋಮಾಳಿ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾಗಿ ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The thin line of hair from his chest to his belly was clearly visible.

definition: a false statement, deceptive appearance or show; a fraudulent or hypocritical action.
example: ಅವನ ಭಕ್ತಿ ಬರೀ ಡೋಂಗು ಎಂದು ಗೊತ್ತಾಯಿತು.
example_en: It became known that his devotion was mere pretence.

definition: a secret love affair between a man and a woman.
example_en: Nobody knew about the secret love affair between the two of them.

definition: (falling, flowing, etc.) in drops and frequently.
example_en: The rain was falling in frequent drops.

definition: any small organism or cell that can develop into a new individual; seed, germ, etc.; a spore.
example_en: A new organism grows from the fungal spores.

definition: the quality of being mean, despicable, contemptible; despicableness.
example_en: Seeing his despicableness, all the villagers were disgusted.

definition: something (as a wheel, attachment, etc.) that turn around or on its own axis.
example: ಪಿರಿಕಿ ಯಂತ್ರದ ಚಕ್ರವು ತನ್ನ ಅಕ್ಷದ ಮೇಲೆ ತಿರುಗಿತು.
example_en: The wheel of the spinning machine turned on its own axis.

definition: a market or street of shops for selling aromatic substances, perfumes or medicinal herbs, other medicinal drugs.
example_en: The fragrance of perfumes had spread in the spice market.

definition: a pance (an oblong, unstitched cloth worn by men round their waist covering the lower part of the body upto the ankles) with a broad coloured border.
example_en: He brought a new broad-bordered dhoti for the wedding.

definition: a dog - a) a domesticated canine (Canis familiaris), raised in many breeds which are commonly kept as house pets and also used for hunting, guarding people or property, etc.; b) any of various wild canines.
example_en: A dog was barking on the street.

definition: (one) more; additional.
example_en: Please give me one more glass of water.

definition: the force of an action; vehemence.
example_en: Trees fell to the vehemence of the storm.

definition: deliberately; intentionally.
example: ಅವನು ಮುದ್ದಮ್ ಆಗಿ ಆ ತಪ್ಪನ್ನು ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: He committed that mistake deliberately.

definition: the act of drawing in or together, raking.
example_en: The raking of dry leaves cleaned the courtyard.

definition: black or blackened throat (as of Śiva).
example: ಶಿವನ ಕಱೆಗೊರಳು ಹಾಲನ್ನು ಕುಡಿದ ನಂತರ ಕಪ್ಪಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Shiva's black throat became black after drinking the poison.

definition: the main entrance in a fort.
example_en: The king's procession passed through the fort's main entrance.

definition: an obstruction or that which obstructs (another's passage, movement, progress, etc.).
example_en: The fallen tree on the road had become an obstruction.

definition: love; affection.
example_en: The love between them was very deep.

definition: finished; completed; done; accomplished.
example_en: The project was completed right on time.

definition: something said or done to arouse laughter or cause amusement; a joke.
example_en: His remark became a joke for everyone.

definition: followed by or relating to the ancient Indian sages.
example_en: This is a text of the ancient sages' tradition.

definition: not orderly; unsystematic; disorderly.
example_en: Everyone's belongings were lying about in a disorderly manner.

definition: the quality, state or fact of being indifferent; lack of concern, interest; apathy; indifference.

definition: relating to, dealing with right and wrong in conduct.

example_en: He gave a lecture on ethical matters.

definition: five times thousand ; five thousand.
example_en: Five thousand people had come to that sacrifice.

definition: the plant Basella rubra of Basellaceae family.
example_en: Grandmother made broth from the basella leaves.

definition: distinguished; notable; of high standing; excellent; eminent.
example_en: He is recognized as a distinguished person in society.

definition: the power, act or process of recalling to mind facts previously learned or past experiences; memory.
example_en: Her memory was still quite good.

definition: a seizure by fits or convulsions, in which the victim loses consciousness but involuntarily keeps uttering some words.
example: ಆತನಿಗೆ ಪ್ರಳಾಪಸನ್ನಿಪಾತ ಬಂದು ಪ್ರಜ್ಞೆ ತಪ್ಪಿ ಏನೇನೋ ಮಾತಾಡಿದನು.

definition: at the back; coming or going behind (another).
example_en: He was standing behind me.

definition: to face in opposition; to meet in hostility or defiance; to confront.
example_en: The enemy army came to confront the king.

definition: the early, free-living, immature form of silk-worm that changes structurally when it becomes an adult by a complex metamorphosis.
example_en: Farmers carefully nurture the young silkworm.

definition: to situate oneself in a place; to make oneself settled.
example: ಅವನು ಹೊಸ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಇಂಬುಗೊಂಡು ನೆಮ್ಮದಿಯಿಂದ ಇದ್ದಾನೆ.
example_en: He has settled himself in the new town and lives peacefully.

definition: a small bar with tapered ends used for the same purpose in hand-spinning; a spindle.
example_en: The grandmother sat winding thread with the spindle.

definition: effective; efficient in bringing a result, esp. good or favourable result.
example_en: This plan is feasible in the present situation.

definition: the act of writing.
example_en: Everyone liked her writing skill.

definition: one who loves or strongly likes.
example_en: He is a devoted lover, he loves nature greatly.

definition: a beautiful neck.

definition: a poison or venom.
example_en: A snake's venom spreads quickly in the body.

definition: (masc.) one who creates fear among others or one who dominates or who manages overbearingly.
example_en: That overbearing man was intimidating the people of the town.

definition: all the people living in a particular district, city, etc.; a community.
example: ಆ ಊರಿನ ಜನವಡೆ ಬರಗಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದಾಗಿ ನಿಂತಿತು.

definition: a votive lamp fixed at a place.
example_en: The votive lamp burned throughout the night at that place.

definition: a very minute space of time equal to six minutes.

definition: the linquistic rules relating to the derivations of different forms from a word.

definition: to cause to become black; to blacken; to darken.

definition: lying on the back; supinely.

definition: a standing or resting on one's knees; a kneeling.

definition: separately; apart (from); exclusively.

definition: the mother of a king.

definition: the act of following religiously a specific system of belief and worship.

definition: the series of people belonging to the same lineage; descendants from a common ancestor.

definition: to have the feeling of distress.

definition: to become more in size, quantity, number or extent.

definition: a strong, unpleasant, offensive smell; stink; stench.
example_en: A stink was coming from the rotten fruits.

definition: (masc.) an elder; an elderly man.
example: ಊರಿನ ಹಿರಿಯ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಸಲಹೆ ನೀಡಿದನು.

definition: of an earlier time; former.

definition: the position or guidance of a leader; leadership.

definition: the left hand.

definition: to receive respectful obeisance.

definition: a man who leads.

example_en: That village's leader has earned everyone's respect.

definition: to prepare for a war; to keep one's army and other preparations ready for a war.
example: ರಾಜನು ಶತ್ರುವಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ದಾಳಿಗೆ ಪಣ್ ಮಾಡಿದನು.

definition: the state of being totally non-effective, useless.

definition: a restraining or being restrained; a restraint.

definition: having qualities; not absolute.

example_en: This cloth is made from material of good qualities.

definition: done, achieved or carried out effortlessly.
example: ಅನಾಯಾಸಕೃತ ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು ಅವನು ಒಂದೇ ದಿನದಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಗಿಸಿದನು.

definition: the act or process of giving a definite shape, form to, by cutting or molding; to shape.
example: ಶಿಲ್ಪಿಯ ಕೈಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕಲ್ಲಿನ ರೂಪಣ ಸುಂದರವಾಗಿ ಮೂಡಿತು.
example_en: The shaping of the stone turned out beautiful in the sculptor's hands.

definition: surrounding area.
example_en: There were green trees in the surrounding area of the fort.

definition: a tooth that is slightly crooked, as in some animals.
example_en: That dog's slightly crooked tooth was a bit bent.

definition: a thick and dark forest.
example_en: They lost their way in the thick dark forest.

definition: he who bends or makes something crooked.
example_en: The blacksmith who bends iron straightened it.

definition: love; affection.
example_en: Love had taken deep root in his heart.

definition: (geom.) a plane figure bounded by four equal straight lines, having four right angles; a square.
example_en: The carpenter cut the wooden plank into a square.

definition: to tear up by the roots; to uproot.
example_en: The rainwater uprooted the plant.

definition: a man who plays a game; a player.
example_en: The gambler sat in the gambling hall.

definition: to deposit a coating of metal on by electrolysis; to electroplate.
example_en: They electroplated the metal parts in the factory.

definition: to conduct a particular rite on the twelfth day from a child's birth.

example_en: On the twelfth day after the child's birth, they conducted the naming rite.

definition: a prose narrative midway between the novel and the short story in length and scope.
example_en: He began to write a novella.

definition: an unbaked earthen pot.
example_en: The pot remained an unbaked earthen pot, not fired in the kiln.

definition: (a girl) to discharge the menses for the first time.
example_en: The news came that the girl had first menstruated.

definition: to shine brightly; to glitter; to glisten.
example_en: The stars glittered brightly in the night sky.

definition: to eject gas spasmodically and noisily from the stomach through the mouth; to eruct; to belch.
example_en: After the meal he belched.

definition: (fig.) a keen sight (as that of a hawk).

definition: a cluster of military quarters built in the shape of a fort.
example_en: The military quarters have been built in the shape of a fort.

definition: to fill (a space) with more quantity than the normal capacity (of something) by squeezing, pressing, etc.; to pack full or too full; to cram; to stuff.
example_en: He stuffed the clothes into the bag.

definition: a sort of fish with gilt-head or golden coloured body.
example_en: The fisherman caught a gilt-head fish in his net.

definition: to become temporarily unconscious.
example: ಗಾಯದ ನೋವಿನಿಂದ ಅವನು ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಹೊತ್ತು ಝೊಂಪಿಸಿದನು.

definition: Yamuna, one of the important tributaries to the river Gangā, in North India.
example_en: The water of the Yamuna joins the Ganga.

definition: the finger next to the thumb; the forefinger.

definition: to talk quietly or furtively, as in gossiping; to whisper.
example_en: The children were whispering and laughing behind.

definition: the front portion of the (human) body.

definition: a doubt; suspicion.

definition: an awakened woman.

definition: difficult to follow, observe (as a way of life, principle, etc.); rigorous.

definition: a touching with the hand.

definition: a kind of skin disease characterised by the skin becoming dark or darker.

example_en: Working in the sun, his skin darkened with the skin ailment.

definition: the part of the human face between the mouth and eyes, having two openings for breathing and which also helps modulate the voice; the nose.

definition: the act of satisfying; gratification; satisfaction.

definition: a great number of people gathered together; a crowd, throng; a multitude.

definition: the quality of being evil; wickedness.

definition: an excellent, superior man.
example: ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನೊಬ್ಬ ಮಾಂತ ಎಂದು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಗೌರವಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: Everyone in the village respected him as a superior, excellent man.

definition: the chief minister in the erstwhile Marāṭha country.
example_en: The Peshwa administered the Maratha kingdom.

definition: a king's female assistant.
example_en: The king's female assistant served the king.

definition: a strong wish; a desire.
example_en: He had a desire to travel.

definition: a similar form or shape.
example_en: These two houses have a similar shape.

definition: to stab with a sharp weapon; to pierce; to butt with the horn.
example_en: The buffalo butted him with its horn.

definition: a condition that is causing irritation or annoyance; irritation; an uncomfortable situation.
example_en: An irritating disturbance started at home due to the children's quarrel.

definition: a person proficient in and licensed to practice medicine, as a physician, surgeon, dentist or veterinarian; a doctor 2.a person holding a degree at the highest level awarded by universities, either as an indication of the successful completion of academic study (as Doctor of Philosophy) or as an honorary degree and title (as Doctor of Laws).
example_en: When I got a fever, I called a doctor.

definition: (masc.) an expert performer of tricks in tumbling or on the trapeze, tightrope, etc.; skilled gymnast; an acrobat.
example: ಸರ್ಕಸ್‍ನಲ್ಲಿ ಆ ಕೊಲ್ಲಟಿ ಹಗ್ಗದ ಮೇಲೆ ನಡೆದನು.
example_en: In the circus, that acrobat walked on the tightrope.

definition: a male or female buffalo.
example_en: That buffalo was grazing in the field.

definition: being grateful.
example_en: He remained grateful to those who helped him.

definition: the reflux of the tide toward the sea; ebb.
example_en: The boats reached the shore during the ebb tide.

definition: to become sour.
example_en: The milk left in the sun quickly turned sour.

definition: the science of numbers; arithmetic.
example_en: The ancient text contained rules of arithmetic.

definition: to cause to anoint or daub.
example_en: Mother had the child's body anointed with oil.

definition: to make (two things) equal, similar; to equalise.
example_en: He equalised the two parts into the same proportion.

definition: a kind of worm.
example_en: A kind of worm called kodativulu was found in the field.

definition: a die or dice that is manipulated in a fradulent manner; cogged dice.
example_en: The cheat used cogged dice and won.

definition: (bot.) an ovary inserted on the receptacle above the other parts; a superior ovary.
example_en: A superior ovary is found in this flower.

definition: the small, lithe, soft-furred animal, Felis cattus of Felidae family, domesticated and kept as a pet or for killing mice; a cat.
example_en: The cat walked softly and caught the mouse.

definition: with throbbing sounds.
example: ಮಳೆಯ ಮೊದಲು ಆಕಾಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಗುಡುಗು ಡವಡವನೆ ಕೇಳಿಸಿತು.
example_en: Before the rain, thunder was heard throbbing in the sky.

definition: a protectivecovering made of metal and used in combat; an armour.
example_en: The soldier wore the armour and set out for the battlefield.

definition: being, acting, interacting between two things, places, stages; intermediate.
example: ಎರಡು ದೇಶಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಆ ದೇಶ ಮಧ್ಯವರ್ತಿ ಪಾತ್ರ ವಹಿಸಿತು.
example_en: That country played an intermediate role between the two nations.

definition: the quality of being ferocious, aggressive and quarrelsome.
example: ಆ ರಾಕ್ಷಸಿ ಲಂಕಿಣಿವಿದ್ಯೆ ಯಿಂದ ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನೂ ಬೆದರಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: That demoness terrified everyone with her ferocious, quarrelsome nature.

definition: a being possessed by an evil spirit.
example: ಆಕೆಗೆ ಗಾಳಿಸೊಂಕು ತಗುಲಿದೆ ಎಂದು ಹಳ್ಳಿಯವರು ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: The villagers said that she was possessed by an evil spirit.

definition: a type of sword.
example_en: A shubhankara sword was hanging at the king's waist.

definition: to follow a proper manner, right way; to be kept, arranged in a proper way; to become beautiful, graceful.
example_en: The disciple's conduct was becoming proper and graceful before the teacher.

definition: the base-structure on which something rests (as the chassis of a vehicle, chariot, etc.).
example_en: The base-structure of the chariot was firmly built.

definition: strength or intensity of power exerted against a person.
example_en: He seized the land using forceful power.

definition: one whose profession is to grind grains into flours.
example_en: The flour-grinder ground the maize finely.

definition: a protruding or swollen belly; a pot-belly.
example_en: Everyone laughed on seeing his pot-belly.

definition: offensive display of superiority or self-importance; overbearing pride; arrogance.
example_en: No one could tolerate his arrogance.

definition: a concerted and serious thought and deep reflection on a subject; cogitation.
example: ಈ ವಿಷಯದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಸಾಕಷ್ಟು ಪರ್ಯಾಳೋಚನೆ ಅಗತ್ಯ.
example_en: Much deep reflection is needed on this matter.

definition: the state of being ceremonially polluted; defilement.
example: ಶವಸಂಸ್ಕಾರದ ನಂತರ ಮನೆಗೆ ಕಿಟ್ಟಮೆ ಬಂದಿತೆಂದು ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: They said the house had ceremonial defilement after the funeral.

definition: a single line, row.
example_en: The students stood waiting in a single line.

definition: sodium chloride; common salt.
example: ಅಡುಗೆ ಉಪ್ಪು ಇಲ್ಲದೆ ಯಾವ ಅಡುಗೆಯೂ ರುಚಿಯಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: No dish tastes good without common salt.

definition: chapped off pieces of meat.
example_en: They fried the chapped off pieces of meat in the pan.

definition: insulting speech; abuse; rebuke.
example_en: Hearing his abuse, she felt insulted.
